edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the deployer inside the constructor.
Constructor sets _owner to the deployer address.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with _owner before renouncing.
lock uses block.timestamp to compute the lock expiry.
unlock reads _lockTime to validate the lock period.
lock stores the current owner in _previousOwner.
unlock reads _previousOwner for the authorization check.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
transfer uses msg.sender as the sender.
transferFrom uses msg.sender for the allowance deduction.
approve uses msg.sender as the owner.
transferFrom subtracts the transferred amount from the allowance.
deliver uses msg.sender as the excluded-account check subject.
excludeFromReward pushes account into the _excluded array.
includeInReward mutates and pops the _excluded array.
setCharityWallet calls excludeFromReward on the new wallet.
setMaxTxPercent performs mul/div arithmetic without bounds validation.
_transfer path can touch _tOwned for excluded accounts.
lockTheSwap modifier sets inSwapAndLiquify around the body.
swapTokensForEth uses uniswapV2Router and reads WETH().
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call.
addLiquidity forwards ETH through an external router call.
Router swap callback can send ETH back into receive().
addLiquidityETH may refund/route ETH into receive().
_tokenTransfer zeroes fees when takeFee is false.
Branch handling transfer to excluded account.
Branch handling transfer from excluded account.
_getTValues computes the tax fee via arithmetic.
_getTValues computes the liquidity fee via arithmetic.
_taxFee is multiplied into the tax fee computation.
_liquidityFee is multiplied into the liquidity fee computation.
_charityFee is multiplied into the charity fee computation.
Reflection amounts are used to update _rOwned.
Reflection amounts feed excluded token balance updates.
Supply values are divided to produce the rate.
time parameter is added to block.timestamp in lock.
enabled flag parameter flows into setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled.
contractTokenBalance local is computed from balanceOf in _transfer.
half local is derived from the contract token balance.
otherHalf local is derived from the contract token balance.
newBalance local captures ETH received during the swap.
tokenAmount parameter is swapped for ETH.
tokenAmount parameter is added as liquidity.
ethAmount parameter is forwarded with the liquidity call.
tFee local is produced from the tax fee computation.
tcharity local is produced from the charity fee computation.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter exists only inside transferOwnership and has no standalone security semantics.
Lock duration is only consumed by lock() arithmetic on block.timestamp.
Recipient argument used only by transfer.
Amount argument used only by transfer.
Sender argument used only by transferFrom.
Amount argument used only by transferFrom.
Spender argument used only by approve.
Amount argument used only by approve.
Amount argument used only by deliver.
Account argument used only by excludeFromReward.
Fee value is only written to _taxFee through setTaxFeePercent.
Fee value is only written to _liquidityFee through setLiquidityFeePercent.
Fee value is only written to _charityFee through setCharityFeePercentage.
Wallet argument is only consumed by setCharityWallet.
Percent argument drives the arithmetic that writes _maxTxAmount.
Toggle argument is only written to swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
From address is only used inside internal _transfer.
To address is only used inside internal _transfer.
Transfer amount is only used inside internal _transfer.
Local balance threshold is computed and consumed inside _transfer.
takeFee local is forwarded directly into _tokenTransfer.
Token balance argument is only consumed by swapAndLiquify.
Half balance is derived and used inside swapAndLiquify.
Remaining balance is derived and used inside swapAndLiquify.
ETH delta is measured and used inside swapAndLiquify.
Token amount is only consumed by the swap call.
Token amount is only consumed by the addLiquidity call.
ETH amount is only forwarded to the router by addLiquidity.
Sender argument is only used by _tokenTransfer dispatch.
Recipient argument is only used by _tokenTransfer dispatch.
Amount argument is only used by _tokenTransfer dispatch.
Fee flag only routes the _tokenTransfer branches.
Amount argument is only used to derive reflection values.
Amount argument is only used to derive token fee values.
Computed tax fee only flows into the _getTValues return tuple.
Computed charity fee only flows into the _getTValues return tuple.
Rate is only multiplied into reflection amounts.
Amount is only multiplied into reflection amounts.
